mechanism: Foscarnet causes dose-dependent nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) that may impair atazanavir absorption and increase cardiovascular risk; both drugs can prolong QT interval.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and cardiac status closely; ensure adequate hydration during foscarnet therapy; consider ECG monitoring and adjust dosing based on creatinine clearance.
